protocol.description: Task-semantic completion built on Moderate data hygiene and physics, with tighter object, endpoint, persistence, and topology criteria. SPT-JEPA fixed disjoint episode split; not a canonical CLEAR manifest.
protocol.name: strict

planning.scope: Custom SPT held-out manifest using pinned CLEAR task semantics and existing SWM planner; not canonical CLEAR benchmark. Released reference weights have different training/data exposure.

path_queries.scope: Same model-owned query prototypes, masks and targets under every intervention. zero_prediction is a prototype/mask-only shortcut control. observed/reversed/other_episode branches access real future encodings; shifted_observed_carry gets a new real observation each step. Only the declared trained mode is an objective-matched score; other heads are descriptive. This is not a task-success metric.

access_contract.observed_future: Actual future encoding: tautological zero-error reference, not prediction.
access_contract.clean_rollout: Only real frame 0 plus executed actions; all subsequent states predicted.
access_contract.teacher_forced_prefix: Each step receives all real past frames through that step; no future frames.
access_contract.shifted_observed_carry: Copies the latest real encoding at every step; extra observations, no learned dynamics.
access_contract.initial_carry: Only initial encoding, repeated over the horizon; no dynamics.
access_contract.interventions: Same clean target; global different-episode initial, zero initial, valid-step action-order shift and other-episode actions.

transition.scope: Frozen clean planner-path diagnostics. No posterior noise, labels, update or task-success claim. Latent MSE scales are model-dependent; compare normalized quantities together with their raw denominators. Existing benchmark_information_audit provides separate probes.

preflight.scope: Reads an existing native short-stage checkpoint; eval-mode FP32 actual objective backward only. No optimizer or update, no new trainer, no probe labels. Positive group norm means some trainable parameters in that declared group participate; it does not require every tensor to have a nonzero gradient.

stage.scope: Existing Lightning Trainer and checkpoint code; only an operational exact-step stop callback is added.
